note: No Blair Court on the plate. The street now called Blair Avenue is the unnamed E-W street at about y 3290 (house numbers 862-951) running from Hartford Avenue (x~2650) east past the N-S street printed 'Ridgeway Ave.' (x~3940) and on past x 4440; its name is not printed in this region (the plate prints BLAIR farther east, at x 7200-8600). Nothing joins it between x 3000 and 3900: the south side is lots 883-921 of Walnut Hills Synd., the north side the large lot 63. Blair Court looks like a later street built across these lots. The nearest junctions are the N-S Ridgeway Avenue at about (3940,3300) and Drexel Place (a T from the south) at about (2830,3300).

Rammelsberg Street runs NW-SE from about (4180,4480) to (4800,5000). No court leaves it near the expected point. At about (4285,4560) the street narrows: its NE edge jogs at a pink/blue lot corner, and from there it continues NW as a narrow strip about 25 ft wide (holding a 12-inch sewer) to about (4090,4460). A 12-inch sewer easement runs NNE from about (4170,4490) through lots 2, 92 and 74; it is not a street. To the east are Cincinnati Model Homes Subdivision row-house lots. Braxton Campbell Court looks like a later street.

An NNW-SSE avenue (house numbers 3204-3279; the name is printed outside the region, only 'AVE.' shows) ends on Gilbert Avenue, which runs along the plate's SE edge. Only the NW part of Gilbert is on the plate, so its centreline is estimated from the NW edge, the track lines and the plate cut. The avenue is about 60 ft wide. This is the same crossing as 69_038.

Billings (a 50-ft N-S street, centre x~6113) ends on Gilbert Avenue. Gilbert's north edge is at about y 4688 here; its south half lies off the plate (only a small stub of plate shows below). The centre is taken at the track lines, about y 4728. Just west of Billings is a diagonal strip and a parcel marked 'City of Cincinnati', probably the future Victory Parkway corridor. Same crossing as 69_039 and 69_040.

Fredonia runs NNW-SSE (labelled south of the junction). An E-W street printed only 'ST.' (house numbers 810-836, with a 4-inch water pipe and 12-inch sewer) comes in from the west and ends on Fredonia; there is no east leg. The north and south legs of Fredonia plus this street make the three-street junction. It is about 310 px south of the expected point; nothing else joins Fredonia nearer that point. Melbourne meets the north leg about 480 px north, at about (2560,4800).

The E-W avenue at the expected point (centre y~1705; house numbers 1600-1661; only 'AVE.' printed, at x~9750) is present. No street meets it near x 8957. At x~8940-8970 the only feature is lot 10 of Johanna White's Subdivision: a 21-ft by 167.64-ft strip lot running north from the avenue (meeting it at about (8955,1705)) to a narrow E-W strip at y~1400. It gives access to the interior lots and is probably where Roselawn Place began, but on the plate it is a lot, not a street. The nearest real streets are Woodburn Avenue, crossing at about (8550,1710), and Greenlawn Avenue, a T from the south at about (9288,1705).

Same crossing as 69_037. An NNW-SSE avenue (house numbers 3204-3279; name not printed in region) ends on Gilbert Avenue at the plate's SE edge. Gilbert's centreline is estimated from its NW edge, the track lines and the plate cut.

Buena Vista Place (about 40 ft wide, running E-W and dipping slightly to the east) ends on the west side of Walters, just north of where Walters meets Gilbert Avenue (about 85 px south, at (4015,6848)). A grey boundary band runs down the middle of Walters and was used as its centreline. The plate prints WALTERS.

Montgomery Road is printed only as 'ROAD' (SW-NE, house numbers 3400-3500, 60 ft wide, with tracks). Its SE side is the plate edge. A small stub of plate at x 10070-10160, y 2025-2125 shows a street leaving to the east, its south edge at about y 2093 and the letters 'DU'. That street is Duck Creek; the rest of it is off the plate. Same crossing as 69_045.
Same crossing as 69_041. Billings ends on Gilbert, whose south half is off the plate. The 'City of Cincinnati' strip just west is probably the future Victory Parkway corridor.
Same crossing as 69_044. The Duck Creek stub at the plate edge leaves Montgomery Road (printed 'ROAD') to the east.

Same situation as 69_009. The present Blair Avenue is the unnamed E-W street at y~3290 between Hartford Avenue (x~2650) and the N-S 'Ridgeway Ave.' (x~3940), and nothing crosses or joins it near x 3170: lots 883-895 and 1-4 lie south, the large lot 63 north. Blair Court is not on the plate. The nearest junctions are Drexel Place (a T from the south) at about (2830,3300) and Ridgeway Avenue at about (3940,3300).

The plate prints BLAIR on the E-W street (house numbers 1500-1557). HARLEM, a N-S street about 60 ft wide between x~7955 and ~8045, comes down from the north and ends on Blair. Fernside appears to be the present name of Harlem.

Walters (its centre marked by a grey boundary band) ends on Gilbert where Gilbert bends from running SSW to running NE. Only the NW part of Gilbert is on the plate, so its centre is estimated at the track lines. Buena Vista Place joins Walters about 85 px north, at (4022,6765).

printed: (not printed; street stub at plate edge)
note: Woodburn Avenue runs N-S (west edge x~8700, east edge at the plate edge x~8796). A small stub of plate at y~420-495 shows a street leaving Woodburn to the east, with a 6-inch pipe along y~460. Its name is not printed. It is taken to be Potter Place.
Same crossing as 69_041 and 69_039. Billings ends on Gilbert, whose south half is off the plate. The 'City of Cincinnati' strip just west is probably the future Victory Parkway corridor.

Reading Road runs NNE with the plate edge along its west side. A small stub of plate at y~590-665 west of the road shows a street printed '...CT.' with a water pipe. That court is taken to be Lee Place. Lexington Avenue meets the road from the east about 85 px south, at about (2320,715).
